隐私 / Privacy

2026-10-26

网页统计

我们通过 PostHog（美国区域）统计页面访问、来源和下载按钮点击。随机浏览器标识保存在本地，用于估算独立访客；不录屏，不采集表单输入。首页不再显示统计开关；浏览器不跟踪设置和拦截工具可能使统计不完整。

App 使用统计

从 0.7.17 起，通过 PostHog 统计应用打开、文字笔记创建和有效录音保存。登录前按随机安装标识统计；登录后用稳定账号 ID 的编码值跨设备去重，不上传邮箱、姓名、密码、笔记正文、录音或转写内容。0.8 移除了设置里的统计开关，仍保留此前已保存的关闭选择。Mac 版从 0.2 起以相同方式统计（同样的事件和账号编码，来源标为 macos），同样没有统计开关。编码标识仍属于可关联的统计标识，并非完全匿名。

关闭统计会停止后续采集；已经收到的事件不会因此自动删除。免费方案的统计数据保留期为一年。同步到 Linko 的笔记遵循 Linko 自身的隐私政策；统计和笔记同步是独立功能。

Website statistics

PostHog (US Cloud) receives page visits, referral information and download clicks. A random browser ID is stored locally to estimate unique visitors. We do not record sessions or collect form inputs. The homepage no longer shows a statistics control.

App statistics

Version 0.7.17 adds app-open, text-note creation and valid voice-capture counts. Before login we count random installation IDs. After login a coded stable account ID deduplicates usage across devices. This is a pseudonymous identifier, not complete anonymity. No email, name, password, note text, audio or transcript is sent. Version 0.8 removes the settings switch and continues to respect previously saved opt-out preferences. The Mac app counts the same way from version 0.2 (same events and coded account ID, marked as macos), also without a settings switch. Previously received events are not automatically deleted. Analytics retention on our free plan is one year.

Analytics is separate from Linko note synchronization. PostHog privacy · Linko
